_comment: Configurable university tier taxonomy. Used to instruct the LLM tier categorization layer without hardcoding institutions in code.

tier_definitions.Tier-1: Premier apex national or international research universities, statutory institutes of national importance, and top-tier global institutions recognized for elite doctoral research output.
tier_definitions.Tier-2: Accredited public state universities, established autonomous deemed universities, and recognized premier private universities with established postgraduate and doctoral programs.
tier_definitions.Tier-3: Accredited regional degree-granting colleges, affiliated non-autonomous undergraduate/postgraduate institutions, and local teaching colleges.
tier_definitions.Unknown: Unrecognized institutions, generic departments/faculties lacking institution names, school boards, or missing institutional information.
